installation.buildEnvironment: This cached realization was built with a prepared Harness development checkout. If that environment is unavailable, re-synthesize from current state rather than treating environment closure as intent.

harnessContribution.scope: only hunks attributable to this patch

maintenance.onSourceOrTargetDrift: Re-investigate current state and re-synthesize the owned contribution; do not silently reuse this candidate.
maintenance.targetBoundary: Transitional direct Harness patch. Move Harness-private mapping to an intent-managed @dsh-std/adapter-dsh realization and retire this ownership path after portable end-to-end acceptance.

uninstall.profileOrphanCleanup: If the exact package symlink remains after remove, unlink it only after the profile manifest, pnpm lockfile, pnpm list, bundle list, and dump config contain no package reference and the symlink resolves to the owned checkout.
uninstall.harnessPatchRemoval: Re-synthesize the current Harness target without this patch; reverse-apply only after proving owned hunks are unchanged and unrelated later changes are preserved.

knownLimits: The exact plugin commit was installed from a local Git worktree; remote retrieval is only a cache-availability concern.
Reusing this exact implementation requires a prepared build environment; regeneration from state may use a different implementation or toolchain.

The separate Harness target is described here but is not a second mechanically validated protocol target, and its mapping has not moved to @dsh-std/adapter-dsh.
